source.name: Swift
source.originalDescription: Shoot 1 large and 3 small star-shaped rays, dealing damage to Pokémon and applying a mark to them after the fourth star hits that lasts 4s. When near a marked Pokémon, Eevee receives a 15% movement speed increase. When Eevee deals damage to a marked Pokémon, its next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Swift は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Moonlight Prance
source.originalDescription: Umbreon briefly becomes unstoppable, leaping up and absorbing 50% of the shields from enemy Pokémon in an area around Umbreon, taking them for the user. Umbreon then lands, dealing damage to Pokémon in an area-of-effect, and stuns them for 1s. For 5s, enemy Pokémon in the area around Umbreon are slowed by 30%, and if an enemy Pokémon in that area is granted a shield, Umbreon absorbs 50% of the shield for themself. Additionally, after learning this move and while not in combat, Umbreon continually recovers 1% Max HP every second. Note: Umbreon cannot steal shields granted by Rayquaza or Assault Vest. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 10% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Moonlight Prance は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、シールドを付与する。
